answer: Random audit slot admission. Each identity commits a key and audit coupon before the epoch beacon; a VRF acts as a prism, splitting the seed into per-key audit slots and partners the attacker cannot precompute. The assignment graph forms a trellis, so selected keys must answer a signed liveness challenge within 30 seconds or be expelled and forfeit the coupon. A knoll of cheap sybils must keep every identity live and pay coupon plus hosting, since any key may be selected.
